title: The Carrion Throne
author: chris-wraight
description: Inquisitor Erasmus Crowl of the Ordo Hereticus walks the labyrinthine hab-layers of Terra — the sacred, rotting Throneworld — hunting a heresy that threatens to eat the Imperium from within. His investigation takes him from the gilded halls of the High Lords to the forgotten underdepths where ten thousand years of Imperial history lie buried.

title: The Hollow Mountain
author: chris-wraight
description: Crowl and Spinoza dig deeper into the conspiracy that snakes through the Palace itself, following leads into the hollow mountain at Terra's heart. Every answer exposes a darker question, and the allies they once trusted may be part of the heresy they hunt.

title: The Dark City
author: chris-wraight
description: The trilogy's conclusion sends Crowl and Spinoza beyond Terra on a journey that will expose the ultimate rot at the heart of the Imperium. In the webway beyond the Throneworld, ancient enemies and older truths wait — and no Inquisitor comes back from the dark city unchanged.
